Each time you apply {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, Burning, or Critically Strike an enemy, they take {c_number}[{SF_0} * 100|%x||%|]{/c} increased damage from you, up to {c_number}[{SF_0} * {SF_1} * 100|%x||%|]{/c}. Your Ultimate Skill damage is increased by {c_number}[SF_4 * 100|%x|]{/c} of your Non-Physical Damage bonus, up to {c_number}[SF_3 * 100|1%x|]{/c}.

Current Bonus: {c_number}[SF_2 * 100|1%x|]{/c}
